scenes.title: The problem
scenes.text: Something breaks at home, late at night. Who do you call? What should it even cost? Most people don't know. Fiakto exists to close that gap.

scenes.title: Publish in under a minute
scenes.text: A photo. One sentence. A pin on the map. That's all it takes to publish a request, no technical vocabulary required. The exact address stays hidden until someone is actually hired.

scenes.title: Gemini classifies it, live
scenes.text: This is Gemini, live, inside Fiakto's production app. It read a real request, a clogged kitchen drain, and returned this: plumbing, normal risk, twenty-five to fifty-five thousand pesos, ninety-five percent confidence. No human wrote this. Gemini did, in seconds, without pretending to know more than it does.

scenes.title: Matched automatically
scenes.text: Only professionals with the right trade, the right coverage area, and a verified profile ever see this request, matched the instant Gemini finishes.

scenes.title: Competing quotes, automated commission
scenes.text: Professionals compete with private quotes. Nobody sees a competitor's price. The customer's address stays hidden until they pay. The moment a quote is accepted, Fiakto's eight percent commission is calculated and recorded automatically, end to end, live.

scenes.title: Talk inside Fiakto, not WhatsApp
scenes.text: Once matched, customer and professional talk inside Fiakto's own chat. Try to share a phone number or an email, and it gets redacted before it's even saved.

scenes.title: Proof of work, live ratings
scenes.text: Closing a job needs a photo of the finished work. The customer reviews it, approves it, and leaves a star rating and a comment. The whole closing flow works, end to end, live.

scenes.title: The promise
scenes.text: Fiakto. Todo tiene solución. Nothing you just saw was a mockup. It's live in production today, end to end, right now, on Fiakto.
